item.title: Global and nonlocal magic of quantum many-body scars
item.description: arXiv:2610.00129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here, using global and nonlocal measures of nonstabilizerness (magic), we study quantum many-body scars in $(1+1)$-dimensional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ lattice gauge theories.
